You turn your shield between the attacker and your friend. The blow is yours to answer now.

Rules

Action
Reaction
Attribute
None (no roll)
Target / range / shape
One adjacent willing ally after a single-target attack is declared and before its roll.
Equipment / acquisition
Use a held ordinary shield (Bulk 1), supplied on learning if needed.
Type
Skill / Defense

Replace the ally as the target if you meet the attack's range and targeting requirements. Resolve the attack against you.
